name: @mjkcart/api
description: Typed client for the MJK Cart API, shared by the Angular and React Native apps.

scripts.schema: cd ../.. && docker compose run --rm -T backend python manage.py spectacular --validate --fail-on-warn --file /app/openapi.tmp.yaml && mv backend/openapi.tmp.yaml packages/api/openapi.yaml
scripts.build: npm run schema && npm run generate
